reset_invalid_body: This password reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Ask an admin to generate a new one.
settings_page_sub: Preferences and credentials for this tracker.
settings_timezone_hint: — used for all date and time display
account_linked_desc: Connect Google or Discord to log in without a password. You always need at least one working login method.
sync_credentials_help: Used by the sync pipeline. Leave a token field blank to keep the existing value. Stored in Postgres — not in the container env file.
sync_cr_token_hint: — etp_rt cookie value from your browser
sync_netflix_cookie_help: Full "cookie" request header value from your browser's devtools (Network tab, any netflix.com request, Request Headers → cookie). Needs the whole thing, not just NetflixId/SecureNetflixId — Netflix's viewing-activity API checks several of the other session cookies too.
sync_netflix_guid_help: From the same devtools capture: any api/aui/pathEvaluator request's POST body decodes to {"guid": "..."}; that value.
sync_manual_desc: Trigger the full sync pipeline on demand instead of waiting for the scheduled run.
sync_outbox_help: Status and progress updates — from bulk edits and from Crunchyroll/Netflix sync alike — are written here immediately and delivered to AniList asynchronously in the background, respecting AniList's rate limit collectively across every source. A sync run finishing "ok" means the updates were staged correctly, not necessarily that every one has reached AniList yet.
sync_csv_import_help: Bootstrap fallback for a large or first-time Netflix account whose full watch history can't reliably complete within Force Full Resync's timeout budget. Download your own export from Netflix (Account → Profile & Parental Controls → Viewing activity → Download all) and upload the CSV here — it's matched against your AniList library the same way a live sync is, and counts as a complete review of your Netflix history once imported.
sync_csv_import_success: Import complete — see Sync history below for details.
sync_export_desc: Download your full library as JSON — includes AniList data, personal notes, tags, and scores.
sync_import_help: Restore drop reasons, notes, tags, and queue priority from a previously exported library.json. Matched by AniList id — only ever writes to your own account, and existing notes are only overwritten after you confirm.
notif_help: Where sync alerts, new-episode alerts, and the weekly digest get sent. Enable a channel and fill in its details — leave secret fields blank to keep the existing value.
notif_telegram_chat_hint: — your Telegram user or chat ID the bot should message
notif_discord_webhook_hint: — from the target channel's Integrations → Webhooks settings in Discord
notif_ntfy_topic_hint: — pick a hard-to-guess name; anyone who knows it can subscribe on the public server
notif_ntfy_server_hint: — defaults to the public ntfy.sh; set your own for a self-hosted server
notif_ntfy_token_hint: — optional, for a private topic or self-hosted server that requires auth
privacy_help: Controls for any feature that shows your library to other users on this instance (e.g. an "also watching" indicator). Nothing is hidden or anonymized by default — these are opt-in.
privacy_hidden_tags_hint: — entries matching any of these never appear to other users, comma-separated
privacy_anonymize_label: Show my activity anonymously ("a user") instead of by name to other users
upcoming_page_sub: New episodes for your watching & planning list.
upcoming_empty: No upcoming episodes — nothing currently airing in your list.
queue_page_sub: Ordered by manual priority, then recommender score. Set a priority from any title's notes page to pin it to the top.
queue_empty: Nothing in your planning or paused list.
notes_drop_reason_placeholder: Why did you drop this? (leave blank if not applicable)
notes_queue_priority_hint: — lower = watch sooner, leave blank for no override
notes_anilist_override_hint: — if AniList links to the wrong entry, set the correct ID here
notes_rewatch_hint: Separate from the general note above — one note per rewatch, so "this rewatch hit different" doesn't overwrite or blend into the original watch's note.
rec_scored_against: scored against your completed & watching history
rec_season_badge_title: New this season — issue #13's seasonal discovery digest
rec_dismiss_not_now_title: Hide for 30 days, then it comes back
rec_empty: No recommendations yet — run the recommender to generate them.
rec_seen_it_hint: Rate it (optional) then confirm to mark as completed on AniList.
lib_search_placeholder: Filter by title, genre or tag…
lib_notes_drop_hint: Add a reason below, then confirm to drop.
admin_users_desc: Login activity and each user's most recent sync run.
admin_deactivate_confirm: Deactivate {email}? They will be logged out immediately and unable to log back in until reactivated.
admin_sync_schedule_help: Times are UTC. Applies instance-wide, to every user's sync. The daily sync runs the full pipeline (Crunchyroll/Netflix fetch → AniList → Postgres). The recommender scores unwatched/planning titles weekly.
admin_privacy_defaults_help: Instance-wide hidden tags/genres for cross-user visibility features — unioned with each user's own hidden-tags list from Settings, never replaces it. Opt-in only: leave empty and nothing is hidden by default.
admin_oauth_desc: Optional — local email/password login always works regardless of these.
admin_instance_health_desc: Read-only sanity check after a deploy or migration — no restart/migrate controls here, display only.
admin_audit_log_desc: Chronological record of admin actions (invites, OAuth settings, privacy defaults, password resets, user deactivation). Most recent first.
admin_backup_desc: Export every user's library data (same query as each user's own Settings → Data export) as one zip, one JSON file per user. Manual trigger only — not scheduled.
